name: Overlapping visits
rule_expression: For same attendant, any two EVVVisit rows where time intervals intersect > 0 minutes on the same date.
result_value: 1 overlap detected on 2026-04-14; overlap window 10:30-12:00 = 90 minutes across two different members.

name: Manual EVV / missing GPS confirmation
rule_expression: count(EVVVisit where capture_method = 'Manual' AND gps_confirmed = 'No') over the service period.
result_value: 12 of 44 visits (27.3%) entered manually with no GPS confirmation.

name: Units above plan of care
rule_expression: For each Claim, flag when units_billed > member.poc_daily_units; overage = units_billed - poc_daily_units.
result_value: 3 dates of service billed above the plan-of-care daily authorization; total overage 12 units.

name: Unsupported units (timesheet / EVV mismatch)
rule_expression: For each Claim, improper_units = units_billed - min(evv_supported_units, timesheet_supported_units); flag when > 0.
result_value: 4 claims with unsupported units; 24 de-duplicated unsupported units total.

name: Personnel documentation gap
rule_expression: Flag when attendant.credential_expiry < date_of_service OR any required personnel doc is missing.
result_value: Certification lapsed 2026-03-31; 8 dates of service rendered after lapse; 2 required personnel documents missing.
